connector.name: Keploy
connector.registryDescription: End-to-end API testing - generate and run tests from OpenAPI, curl, Postman, or real user traffic.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.keploy.io over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the keploy account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Keploy API key as a Bearer token. Generate a one-time-viewable key at https://app.keploy.io/settings/api-keys, then paste the full header value including the 'Bearer ' prefix (e.g. 'Bearer kep_...').
